ethical_standards.fairness_constraints: AI must never offer differential pricing based on race, gender, or orientation.
ethical_standards.transparency_rules: All policy exclusions must be actively displayed and highlighted upfront in natural language.
ethical_standards.explainability_policy: For every recommended product, the system must provide a minimum of 3 primary logic reasons.

drift_and_bias_controls.fallback_protocol: Automated rollback to the last verified prompt version if high variance is detected.

data_safety.encryption_standard: AES-256 in transit and at rest.
